inputs_actually_read_this_phase.purpose: Supplied fictional evidence, claims M1 through M6.
Rechecked intended audience and preservation constraints.
Sealed first proposal and source snapshot for the corrective plan.
Resolved the distinction between a record-bounded absence and an event in the world.

corrections.issue: The proposal stated that no medication order had been entered without preserving the source limitation to the supplied record.
corrections.change: Inserted in the supplied record after no medication order has been entered.
corrections.reason: The absence of an entered order in the supplied record does not establish that no order was entered elsewhere.

selected_claims_checked.finding: Reported light-headedness remains linked to standing.
Both blood-pressure values, mmHg units, seated posture, standing posture and two-minute interval match the evidence.
The dose reduction remains a suggestion during review. The final now limits the absence of an entered order to the supplied record.
Previous-evening timing, reported near-fainting and absence of reported loss of consciousness are preserved; no confirmed loss-of-consciousness claim is added.
The final preserves uncertainty about the cause without naming a diagnosis or adding management advice.

conformance.judgment: The source phase made one localized qualification and no new stylistic revisions.
conformance.basis: The exact-span tool completed without errors, preserving all text outside the insertion. Reader-stage files were not modified; reader-after.txt still matches its sealed hash.

correctness.judgment: The selected final claims are supported by the supplied fictional source packet after the M4 correction.
correctness.limit: This establishes source fidelity within the supplied packet, not independent clinical truth or medical validation.

usefulness.judgment: The four-word addition usefully marks the documentation boundary for the clinician reader.
usefulness.limit: This is an editorial assessment; no reader study or clinical evaluation was performed.

measurements.note: Token alignment includes the changed punctuation attachment at entered; the plan itself is one insertion.

remaining_limits: Only the supplied fictional record was checked. No fuller record, later documentation or independent evidence was consulted.
The record does not establish a cause or authorize converting the suggested dose reduction into an order.
No treatment or diagnostic-management recommendation was added.
status: Source check complete; final candidate saved separately from the preserved reader proposal.
